networkSeeds.asnsTitle: AS numbers registered to this name
networkSeeds.empty: Add your AS numbers or your organization name to find the address ranges that are yours.
networkSeeds.expanding: Looking it up in public routing data…
networkSeeds.intro: AS numbers and organization names that are yours. Each is looked up in public routing data (RIPEstat; the value is sent there): an AS number lists the address ranges it announces, which you can add as scope entries; an organization name lists the AS numbers registered to it. A seed never lets a scan reach anything by itself, scope entries do.
networkSeeds.lookupFailed: The last lookup failed; it is retried later.
networkSeeds.lookups.description: Your AS numbers and organization names are sent to RIPEstat to find your address ranges. Turn this off to keep them private; network seeds are then not looked up.
networkSeeds.lookups.title: Network seed lookups
networkSeeds.lookupsOff: Lookups in public routing data are turned off for your organization (Attack surface › Monitoring). Seeds are kept but not looked up.
networkSeeds.noAsns: No AS number is registered to this name.
networkSeeds.removeDesc: Scope entries you added from it stay. Addresses in this network no longer get the range offered in the review queue.
networkSeeds.shared: This network belongs to a cloud or CDN provider that serves many organizations. Its prefixes are not offered as scope entries; add your own addresses one by one.
